text:
maria: Heads-up — planning an anchor-bank refresh ahead of the q8 bring-up. Need to prune near-duplicates, refresh canary prompts (EN/ES), and carve out a small golden relabel batch. thinking: 1k examples per high-priority intent.

arjun: SGTM. For dedupe i want a two-step: cheap shingled hash to catch exact/near-exact, then embed-cluster threshold at 0.88 for semantic duplicates. keeps diversity but removes noise.

sam: I can run the embed pass tomorrow. quick script i usually use:
```bash
# sample pipeline
python tools/sample_bank.py --bank anchors.db --nb_examples 5000 --lang en,es \n  --dedupe-method hash+embed --embed-model text-embed-001\n  --out samples/anchor_candidates.jsonl
```

labeler-jess: For golden relabel, prefer overlapping 10% with current golden so we can measure drift. Also mark 20% long-context (>2k tokens) candidates for kv/cache checks.

jonah: Important: add ~200 long-context 'stress' prompts to canary to exercise kv cache + streaming edgecases for quant path. q8 tends to trip on cache eviction patterns.

maria: Good call. So concrete action items:
- sam: run dedupe + produce seed lists (en/es) by EOD tomorrow
- labeler-jess: produce 500 candidate golden examples (include 100 long-ctx)
- arjun: run quant bench on staging cluster with two configs: q8-perf (aggressive) and q8-safe (slightly looser) and report exec memory + token/s

arjun: I'll run bench with these flags: `--quant q8 --kernels fused_attn_v2 --batch_scheduling adaptive` and collect: p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, peak GPU mem. Expect token/s down ~25-35% vs fp16 but peak memory ~40% lower (rough estimate).

sam: starting embed dedupe now. small note: tokenizer changes between model versions can cause false duplicates — normalizing whitespace + html-entity decode reduces false negatives.

labeler-jess: Routing question: should relabel go to internal label team or external pool? internal preferred for tricky long-context and legal edgecases.

maria: internal for golden. external can handle broader sampling once seed set is clean.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: `quant-q8-2026-03-canary` -> staging at 1768810010. Route: 2% production traffic (canary flag), fallback to fp16-master.

qa-bot: Canary smoke done: initial pass shows 1) small latency bump p95 +50ms, 2) one memory surge on model-instance-7 at 1768810125 (OOM avoided via fallback). attaching logs to the canary dashboard.

arjun: thanks — i'll correlate the surge with kernel trace. might be an allocation regression in fused_attn_v2 for sequences > 1k. will run targeted repros.

sam: dedupe run complete. produced `anchor_candidates_1768809999.jsonl` -> 5,200 raw -> 3,900 post-hash -> 2,800 post-embed-threshold. uploading to gs://redwood-curation/anchors/1768809999/

labeler-jess: will pull that path and start golden tagging tomorrow morning. I'll create an overlap set with current golden of 120 examples.

maria: Perfect. Let's reconvene after arjun's bench and labeler initial pass. If the bench looks good we flip canary to 10% and start broader sampling. Thanks all :rocket:

arjun: FYI i'll post bench artifacts + kernel traces to the bench channel.

jonah: add a quick eval set for hallucination regression too — 200 examples focused on attribution.

maria: Added to action list.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

labeler-jess: ack, ping me if any sample needs de-iding before labeling.

maria: closing loop here — i'll update the runbook with the new anchor refresh steps and canary checklist.

qa-bot: Note: timeline estimate updated in dashboard — next check at 1768812000.
